title.value: Towards technological adaptation of advanced farming through AI, IoT, and Robotics: A Comprehensive overview
title.justification: Based on the information provided, this is the title of the paper as mentioned in the chapter details.
title.quote: Chapter : Towards technological adaptation of advanced farming through AI, IoT, and Robotics: A Comprehensive overview

extractions.description: This paper explores the implementation and potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and Robotics in modern agriculture. It addresses technological advances that provide solutions to issues like food security and environmental sustainability, offering detailed insights into how these technologies increase efficiency, reduce resources, and improve overall agricultural productivity. The chapter provides an overview of current implementations, challenges, and future directions for AI, IoT, and Robotic methodologies in agriculture.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on food security and sustainable farming through AI, IoT, and Robotics, directly addressing ecological and sustainability challenges in agriculture.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: making food security a significant anxiety for most countries... AI, IoT, and Robotics-based devices and methods have produced new paradigms and opportunities in agriculture.

primary_category.justification: The central theme is utilizing technology to enhance agricultural efficiency and sustainability, which aligns with mitigating climate change impacts through advanced farming methods.
primary_category.quote: AI, IoT, Robotics technology will save countless hours of labor, collect crops in actual time, provide more food with fewer resources... decrease the use of chemicals, minimize environmental pollution.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper addresses adaptation measures to global warming issues, which is a part of climate change adaptation efforts in agriculture.
secondary_categories.quote: ...global warming, and carbon footprint resulting in a drastic increase in floods as well as droughts thus making food security a significant anxiety.

primary_sub_category.justification: The entire focus of the paper is on utilizing AI, IoT, and Robotics for improving agricultural practices, thus sitting primarily under the sub-category of Agriculture.
primary_sub_category.quote: AI, IoT, and Robotics-based devices and methods have produced new paradigms and opportunities in agriculture.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper discusses ensuring food security through advanced technology, which is an adaptation strategy.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: making food security a significant anxiety for most countries.

applications.value: Soil management, crop disease identification, weed identification and management using AI and IoT
applications.justification: These applications directly relate to reducing the environmental impact of agriculture and improving food production efficiency.
applications.quote: AI's existing approaches are soil management, crop diseases identification, weed identification, and management in collaboration with IoT devices.

applications.value: Precision farming and real-time crop monitoring with IoT
applications.justification: Precision farming is a method to optimize agricultural inputs for sustainable outcomes.
applications.quote: IoT has utilized automatic agricultural operations and real-time monitoring with few personnel employed in real time.

applications.value: Robotic soil preparation, planting, monitoring, harvesting, and storage
applications.justification: These are critical operations in farming that robotics can optimize, aiding in resource conservation and efficiency.
applications.quote: The major existing applications of agricultural robotics are for the function of soil preparation, planting, monitoring, harvesting, and storage.

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories cover the paper's focus areas adequately without needing a new category.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories sufficiently capture the detailed focus on agriculture within climate change mitigation.
